title: total_supply_equals_sum_of_balances
description: totalSupply always equals the sum of balanceOf over all accounts.

title: shares_backed_by_pot_pie
description: The normalized Pot balance held by SavingsDai (pot.pie(sDAI)) is always at least totalSupply, so every outstanding share is backed by one unit of pie.

title: zero_and_self_hold_no_shares
description: The zero address and the SavingsDai contract itself never hold shares.
